name: The Travel of Hello Cool
description: Under the cute appearance, the robot Xiaoku has an unruly heart. It is optimistic, free and easy, loves freedom, and dares to take risks and explore the unknown journey in life. Also accompanying him was his pet dog, Diandian, who acted cute and cute all the way, throwing objects and picking them up, and circling around Xiaoku, which added great fun to the journey. A suitcase is all they have outside of them. They bravely travel to the ends of the world, enjoy life, and start one trip after another at the drop of a hat.
